shigeru-ohkido.name: Shigeru Ohkido
shigeru-ohkido.title: Pokémon Researcher
shigeru-ohkido.blurb: Grandson of famed Professor Ohkido and rival to former Indigo Champion Red, Shigeru Ohkiado is currently the Gym Leader of Viridian City. Shigeru is a former Indigo League Champion in his own right so he's no pushover.
